name: Text
purpose: The one general text label for titles, names, metadata lines, counts, captions, stats, inline values, helper and footnote lines, toast and lightbox text. Named Text rather than Label so it does not collide with the shadcn/Radix form Label. Covers A's Text rows and B's Text rows. A's Description rows (helper text, footnote, settings row description, shortcut error line) are Text with as p, tone muted or danger, and live. Headings go to Heading and SectionHeader, search highlights to MatchHighlight, timestamps to RelativeTime, and the character counter to CharacterCounter. Sizes are in rem with 1rem = 14px. A's ten 0.5px steps are snapped to four named steps (B's fold, ties going up). Sources: A (labels.json rows and lens) and B (consolidated). Also (structure): Single-line text in a task row: the title and the secondary subtitle. Both truncate. Folds in RelativeTime: Text with as=time, a dateTime prop (the machine-readable value is kept) and the existing tooltip prop. The folded widget's role stays time, since RelativeTime is already a time element with implicit role time, so the role is not changed. A rejected this on the assumption that Text would become role none, which this variant does not do. Index line 50 says B folds it to Text with tooltip. The claim that Text already wraps itself in a Tooltip when the tooltip prop is set is B's and is unverified.
base: none (plain styled span, p or div; not a Radix primitive). Wrapped in a Radix Tooltip only when the tooltip prop is set.

props.name: as
props.description: Element. Default span. p for helper, footnote and error lines. div for block rows. Heading levels are not here; they belong to Heading.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Default false. True lets the user select and copy the text. Used for app version value (A SelectableText).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Full value shown on hover and keyboard focus when the text is truncated, so the full name can be read.

props.name: live
props.description: Default off. Set polite on the shortcut error line so the rejection is announced when it appears (from A Description).

props.name: at
props.description: Moment; becomes the dateTime attribute of the time element.

props.name: relative
props.description: Relative phrase shown in the row, for example 1w ago or 5d ago.

props.name: absolute
props.description: Full date and time shown in the tooltip, for example Nov 6, 2026, 9:00 AM.

states: done (struck or faded, per the done axis)
matched (contains a MatchHighlight child inside a title or note)
unbound (tone inherit, italic, caller passes the text None)
announced (live polite or assertive on the shortcut error line)
role: none (span, p and div carry no role). Headings use Heading or SectionHeader.
keyboard: Not focusable. Where text is a tooltip trigger (truncated text, timestamp, reduced-motion status, truncated lightbox file name) the owning row or control must be tabbable (tabIndex 0) so keyboard users reach the tooltip. Escape dismisses it. / None.
platform: Same widget on web and desktop. Differences are in content, not the widget. Desktop-only strings (Saved to, Data folder, capture rows, Low Power Mode, the macOS footnotes) do not appear on web. The sheet detail string '⌘Z puts it back' needs a per-platform string (Ctrl+Z on Windows and web). The native title tooltip is replaced by the Radix Tooltip on both. Web: browsers select text by default, so chrome labels need user-select none to match the desktop feel; the reference marks only app version value as selectable. / Same.
open: 1) Size steps: A's ten 0.5px steps are merged to xs, sm, md, base plus inherit (B's snap, ties up). Confirm the snap; it sets the rem values. 2) Conflict on the default size: A default 13 (md), B default base (14). Kept md (A). Confirm. 3) Conflict on the trash task title: A 13.5px regular (uncertain; measured estimate about 14px regular); B folds to base 14px regular. Kept base regular and flagged uncertain; it differs from the list title only in weight. Confirm. 4) Done task title is muted with strike (measured). Decide whether it takes the done-lamp colour (the brief) or stays muted. 5) Conflict on the done task note preview: A keeps faded (opacity 55%); B folds it to tone muted. Kept faded because it is a visible fade distinct from muted. Confirm. 6) Conflict on the unbound shortcut placeholder tone: A inherit (assumed), B muted. Kept inherit (colour not measured; it takes the keycap colour). Italic kept (catalogue lists Italic). Size inherits the keycap. Confirm. 7) Menu shortcut hint tone muted is assumed (not measured). 8) Attachment tile caption weight regular is assumed. 9) Lightbox status card helper: colour not measured; proposed onMediaMuted over the dark lightbox. It may be an error and need danger. Decide. 10) Lightbox position counter alpha 55% folded to 60%. Confirm. 11) Title-bar project pill owner: A puts it in Heading, B in Text with a display font. Merged to Heading (see Heading open). Confirm. 12) Shortcut error line live polite is proposed (A Description). 13) Settings row description 11.5px (A) folded to 12px (sm, B). Confirm. / B lists the task row title and subtitle as notWidgets owned by a task-row text widget in another family. Kept here per A's measured type scale; the owner can move it. Subtitle is recorded only on the t-pharmacy row. No due-date text (dropped by decision). No full-title tooltip is recorded for truncated text.
